description: Search OECD dataflows by keyword or theme, matching each query token at the start of a word in dataflow names and descriptions, with name matches ranked first. Returns flow_ref identifiers, names, and agency IDs for use with oecd_get_dataset_info.

agency_id.description: Optional agency identifier to restrict the search scope — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD". Obtain valid agency IDs from oecd_list_agencies.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20; a larger value returns at most 2,000 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first match to return within the ranked match list, applied before limit. Page through results past the limit by advancing it; an offset at or past total_matches returns an empty list.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for in dataflow names and descriptions — e.g. "GDP", "house prices", "TiVA". Every whitespace-separated token must start a word in the name or description, ignoring case: "price" matches "Prices" and "tiva" matches "(TiVA)", but "tiva" does not match "activation". A word starts after any character that is not a letter or digit, or at a lowercase-to-uppercase step ("markers" matches "RioMarkers"). A token that opens on such a character, like "&" or "-oecd", matches anywhere it occurs: "&" finds "R&D".

name: oecd_search_datasets

dataflows.description: Matching dataflows for the requested page, up to the requested limit, ranked in three tiers: the name carries every token; the tokens are split across name and description; the description alone carries every token. Catalog order holds within each tier.

description.description: Plain-text abstract of what the dataset covers, truncated to 240 characters. Matching runs against the full abstract, so a term reported in matched_in may sit past the cut. Absent when OECD publishes no description for the dataflow.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference — {agencyID},{dsd_id}@{df_id}, or {agencyID},{df_id} for the few dataflows OECD publishes without a datastructure prefix. Pass through unchanged to oecd_get_dataset_info or oecd_query_dataset.

matched_in.description: Which field carried every query token at a word start — "name" or "description" when only that one did, "both" when each did on its own or the tokens were split across the two.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No dataflows matched the search query. `agency_not_found`: The supplied agency_id does not exist in the OECD SDMX catalog. `rate_limited`: OECD throttled the request rate and was still refusing after the retries, or asked for a wait longer than the call's upstream budget had left. `upstream_timeout`: An OECD request ran past OECD_TIMEOUT_MS, or the call's requests and retries together ran past its upstream budget — 50 seconds, or OECD_TIMEOUT_MS when that is longer. `upstream_unavailable`: OECD returned a server fault or was unreachable once the retries ran out. `upstream_redirect`: The configured OECD host answered with a redirect, which this server never follows. `upstream_error`: OECD refused the request with a status this server does not model — an authorization challenge, a rejection from something sitting in front of the API, a request read as malformed or unprocessable (HTTP 400 or 422), or a method it does not implement (HTTP 501). `upstream_unreadable`: OECD answered with a body this server could not read — not JSON, or JSON whose fields do not have the shape SDMX gives them. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Present when a requested limit was above the per-call maximum, naming the limit requested and the one served.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first returned result within the ranked match list.

result_count.description: Number of results returned (may be less than total_matches).

totalCount.description: Total dataflows matching the query, disclosed when matches remain beyond the returned page.

total_matches.description: Total dataflows matching the query before applying offset and limit.

title: Oecd Search Datasets
